name: DESK Participant Workspace
purpose: Provide a participant dashboard/workspace that composes economic, identity, activity, obligation, opportunity and notification capabilities without owning their universal semantics.
authority_model: Dashboard presentation does not grant authority; consequential actions resolve through canonical authority and authorization.
data_model: References canonical records instead of creating parallel identity, value or ledger semantics.
evidence_model: Displays and links source evidence; presentation is not evidence by itself.
pulse_model: May present Pulse signals without redefining them.
continuity_model: Workspace replacement must preserve participant records and active obligations.
exit_handoff: Persist context and links to canonical records; hand active work to the receiving capability.
